## R Markdown

```{r}
library(cfbfastR)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)

if (!nzchar(Sys.getenv("CFBD_API_KEY"))) {
  stop("CFBD_API_KEY is not set. Add it to .Renviron before running this notebook.")
}

# Pull and combine 2014–2024
coach_hist <- map_dfr(2014:2024, function(y) {
  message("Pulling year: ", y)
  df <- cfbd_coaches(year = y)
  df$year <- y
  df
})

#Loading the 2025 data manually
coach_import <- cfbfastR::cfbd_coaches(year = 2025)

all_coach <- coach_import |>
  select(first_name, last_name, school, year, games, wins, srs) |>
  mutate(FullName = paste(first_name, last_name)) |>  # Create FullName column
  select(-first_name, -last_name)  |> 
  select(FullName, everything())

coach_2014 <- coach_import |>
  select(first_name, last_name, school, year, games, wins, srs) |>
  mutate(FullName = paste(first_name, last_name)) |>  # Create FullName column
  select(-first_name, -last_name)  |> 
  select(FullName, everything()) |>
  filter(year >= 2014)

coach_2014 <- na.omit(coach_2014)

coach_2014 <- all_coach[!(coach_2014$FullName == "Marcus Freeman" & coach_2014$year == 2021), ]
write.csv(coach_2014, "coaches_2014.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
coach_2025 <- read.csv("coaches_2014_1.csv")
coach_2025 <- coach_2025 %>% select(-losses)
coach_2025 <- coach_2025 %>%  mutate(win_per = ifelse(games > 0, wins / games, NA_real_)
                            ) %>% select(FullName, school, year, games,wins, srs, win_per)

```


```{r}
coach_hist <- coach_hist %>%
  select(
    first_name,
    last_name,
    school,
    year,
    games,
    wins,
    srs
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    FullName = paste(first_name, last_name),
    win_per = ifelse(games > 0, wins / games, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  select(FullName, school, year, games, wins, srs, win_per)


```

```{r}
all_coach_data <- bind_rows(coach_hist, coach_2025)
all_coach_data
```

#Creating the functions
```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Cumulative mean win percentage
calculate_mean_win_percentage <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    arrange(FullName, year) %>%
    group_by(FullName) %>%
    mutate(MeanWinPercentage = cummean(win_per)) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# Cumulative mean SRS
calculate_mean_srs <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    arrange(FullName, year) %>%
    group_by(FullName) %>%
    mutate(MeanSrs = cummean(srs)) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# Years coached counter
calculate_years_coached <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    arrange(FullName, year) %>%
    group_by(FullName) %>%
    mutate(YearsCoached = row_number()) %>%
    ungroup()
}
```

#Applying the functions
```{r}
all_coach_data <- all_coach_data %>%
  calculate_mean_win_percentage() %>%
  calculate_mean_srs() %>%
  calculate_years_coached()
```

#Creating the final rating
```{r}
all_coach_data <- all_coach_data %>%
  mutate(
    rating = MeanSrs + MeanWinPercentage + (YearsCoached * 0.5)
  )
export_csv = all_coach_data |>
  filter(year >= 2014)

season_2025 = all_coach_data |>
  filter(year == 2025)

#write.csv(export_csv, file = "coach_ratings.csv")
```
